human_summary: Current v1 bounded price-impact guard around a target trade, with standalone guarded front and back impact outputs.
assumptions: The current v1 public contract is magnitude-based and does not by itself encode directional sandwich intent.
All price inputs are bv32 values and params_ok includes positivity, max_bps <= 10000, and the documented safe-range bound.
Standalone outputs o2 and o3 are required to be gated by params_ok in the public contract.

intended_preconditions: o2 and o3 are standalone guarded outputs and must not report success when params_ok is false.

analysis_partitions.intent: Parameter gate blocks every stronger output.
Front-run impact rejects while back-run impact passes.
Back-run impact rejects while front-run impact passes.

outputs.name: o1
outputs.contract_formula: o1 = 1 iff prices are positive, max_bps <= 10000, and all four prices lie within the documented safe multiplication range

outputs.name: o2
outputs.contract_formula: o2 = 1 iff params_ok holds and the absolute front-run price move is within max_price_impact_bps

outputs.name: o3
outputs.contract_formula: o3 = 1 iff params_ok holds and the absolute back-run price move is within max_price_impact_bps

outputs.name: o4
outputs.contract_formula: o4 = 1 iff o1, o2, and o3 all hold under the current magnitude-based v1 contract

theorems.statement: For all inputs, o2 and o3 are exactly the guarded front/back impact predicates and never claim success when params_ok is false.
For all inputs, o4 is exactly the current v1 aggregate magnitude-based impact guard.
Distinct sandwich_detection_v1 output-vector regions are pairwise disjoint over the explicit input domain.
The sandwich_detection_v1 behavior atlas covers the explicit input domain.
The contract semantics and the Tau binary agree on the bounded assurance domain for sandwich_detection_v1.

evidence_links.note: The assurance registry already checks guarded standalone outputs and aggregate implications for sandwich_detection_v1.
